notes.5: The question required an identification of the entry which would correct the nominal ledger as a result of the sales journal being undercast. The incorrect total of the sales ledger would have been debited to the sales ledger control account and credited to the sales account in the nominal ledger. The trial balance would have balanced, therefore the two options which included a suspense account should have been disregarded. Most candidates opted for a key which included an entry to the suspense account. The key was D which increased total sales and the balance on the sales ledger control account.
